historicalStatements: V32 IS A NEW PROSPECTIVE PHASE
stopRule: Any pre-launch failure permanently stops V32; no same-phase repair or retry. Post-stop helpers perform additive evidence/Git closeout only, not qualification.

lifecycleAccountingDefinitions.budgetAuthority: Authorized request count, not completed receipt count
lifecycleAccountingDefinitions.completionAuthority: Sequential actualSessionRunCount receipts from 1 without gaps, duplicates or excess
lifecycleAccountingDefinitions.terminalCancellation: At most one authorized in-flight real.run request per cell; only with every strict normal/context terminal witness prescribed by the V32 user protocol; never inferred from a missing completion receipt alone
lifecycleAccountingDefinitions.interval: Completed receipts C and fully evidenced terminal cancellation K yield internal execution interval [C,C+K]; do not claim canceled request completed or did no GPU work
lifecycleAccountingDefinitions.unknownFormulaForbidden: Missing receipts are not by themselves hidden execution; all unexplained lifecycle work blocks success

identityPolicy: Each record names domain, representation and subject. Protected remote source compares Git objects START vs result/freeze; historical local provenance remains a separate materialization check. No EOL normalization, checkout or Git config change.
semantics: Score-blind acquisition/inference/decoder/publication/H50; runtime-only target verdict; original H50 addition construction, not subtraction equality; captured-through retirement; synchronous rearm; no fixed cooldown
CI: Deferred by product owner, not a qualification gate. Local tests are not CI. Query exact final remote statuses/workflows; absent means NOT CI PASS.
closeout: Preserve first failure; no qualification retry or frozen/historical edits. Additive result/remote evidence only. STOP_FOR_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT. No next-phase proposal, product integration or capability promotion.
